text:
Anya Petrov: Putting a single ask here for Delta+VoltCloud+Aurora inputs so cost model ingestion is consistent. Need CSV + monthly supply per region + blackout windows + volume ladder.

Diego Ramos: Can you share the exact CSV header? I'll send to vendor contacts.

Anya Petrov: Header to use:
```
vendor,sku,gpu_family,reserve_3m_usd,reserve_6m_usd,reserve_12m_usd,spot_p50_usd,spot_p90_usd,blackout_months,lead_time_days,min_commit_units,early_term_fee_pct,volume_ladder,region_capacity_map,preempt_profile,disclosure_allowed,marketplace_listing_fee_pct
```

Priya Kapoor: Finance asks to include `effective_unit_usd` in the sheet (calculated) and `marketplace_revenue_share_tier`. Also add `cap_on_spot_pct` if vendor guarantees a max spot share.

Anya Petrov: Adding those columns. Vendors: please provide p50/p90 rather than std where possible. If you only have percentiles, that's fine.

Diego Ramos: VendorOpsBot, can you confirm ingest path and ACL? We'll drop uploads to s3://redwood-internal/partners/batch-2115/

VendorOpsBot: Ack. Dropzone monitored. Ingestion job will pick CSVs with prefix `2115-` and write to cost-model bucket.

Priya Kapoor: Legal note: mark `disclosure_allowed=no` for any SKU that cannot be listed publicly. That changes marketplace treatment and might force private-only pricing.

Diego Ramos: Also asking vendors to supply a month-by-month `eviction_rate_pct` series (12 values) and a short note on their preempt profile (NO_NOTICE / 5MIN_NOTICE / 24H). Helps Monte Carlo.

Anya Petrov: Ops follow-ups: (1) ensure region_capacity_map format = "region:units;region:units"; (2) volume_ladder like "1:0;100:-8;500:-15"; (3) blackout_months semi-colon separated.

VendorOpsBot: Ingest watcher configured: prefix=2115-, target=s3://redwood-internal/partners/batch-2115/, notification on success.

Priya Kapoor: Once ingests complete, FinanceBot will run effective_unit_usd under low/med/high marketplace fee bands and return a CSV with `scenario_tag`.

FinanceBot: Noted. Will run batch compute when artifacts appear. Please ensure `reserved` prices are per-GPU-hour or clearly documented unit.

Anya Petrov: Thanks. Target: get vendor responses by Tue EOD so models can run Wed. If any vendor resists sharing p90 or eviction series, escalate to me.
